का.आ. 4467(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 956 (7956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (() के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2866 तारीख 30/06/2023, जो भारत के राजपपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के हस्सान जिले में ग्रीनफील्ड हाईवे 
के कि.मी. 7.54 से कि.मी.37.00 (स्पैषल्‌ aes एक्नज़िषन्‌ औफस अरसीकेरे) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण 
(चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "22-07-2023 " 
को "SHAT SCS" और "संयुक्त कर्नाटक" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

5.0. 4467(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2866 Dated:30/06/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. !7.54 to Km. 37.00 (Special Land Acquisition Office 
Arasikere) in the district of HASSAN in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Deccan Herald” and “Samyuktha 
Karnataka’ both dated 22-07-2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act;

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


9.0. 4471(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1181 Dated:13/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH754A in the stretch of land from Km. 144 to Km. 155 (DRO office, Bathinda) in the district of BATHINDA in 
the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Indian Express” and “Punjabi 
Jagran” both dated 30.03.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 2th October, 2023 


9.0. 4470(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 988 Dated:0/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH347-B in the stretch of land from Km. 33.6 to Km. 49 (Khandwa) in the district of KHANDWA in the state of 
MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Free-Press” and Nayiduniya both 
dated 0/05/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and allowed / disallowed by 
the competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4464(E).— hereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. No. 2863 Dated:30/06/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3,

the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and

BIHAR.

Khabar” both dated 05.07.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority (District Land Acquisition Officer, East Champaran) ; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government;

conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

S.O. 4445(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (i) of section 20A of the Railways 
Act, 989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred in as the said Act), the Central Government after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
execution of Special Railway Project, namely, Ratlam — Indore - Dr. Ambedkar Nagar - Khandwa Gauge Conversion 
Project in the State of Madhya Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land: 
Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for a foresaid purpose under 
sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act: 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Sub-Divisional Officer & Land 
Acquisition Officer, Dr. Ambedkar Nagar, District- Indore (M.P.), in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and 
the competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner 
and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any as the competent authority 
thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (ID) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be 
final. 


The Land Plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person aforesaid Office of the Competent Authority.

to acquire the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying 
“Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline” for the transportation of LPG in Tehsil- Kerakat, District-Jaunpur in the state of 
Uttar Pradesh by IHB Limited. 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public up to 24 June-2023 
and whereas Shri Rakesh Kumar Competent Authority has under sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act submitted 
report to the Central Government; 


And whereas the Central Government, after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of user therein;

notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4479(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH309A in 
the stretch of land from Km. 80 to Km. 206 (Special Land Acquisition Officer, Almora, associate Bageshwar) in the 
district of BAGESHWAR in the state of UTTARAKHAND, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer. 
(SLAO), Almora. in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector 
an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 4493(अ).--केंद्रीय सरकार, रेल अधिनियम, 989 (7989 का 24) (जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त 
अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 20क के उपखंड (I) ST प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते Sa, ये समाधान हो जाने के 
पश्चात्‌ कि लोक प्रयोजन के लिए, यह भूमि, जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में दिया गया है, गुजरात राज्य 
में जिला अहमदाबाद में बारेजडी नान्देज (गेरतपुर)- साणंद के बीच में चौथी लाइन परियोजना(38.20 की. मी.) नाम की 
विशेष रेल परियोजना के निष्पादन के लिये आवश्यक है, ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन करने के आशय की घोषणा करती है; 


उक्त भूमि के कोई हितबद्ध व्यक्ति, राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर, उक्त 
अधिनियम की धारा 20घ की उप-धारा (4) के अधीन उपर्युक्त प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन और उपयोग के संबंध में 
अपनी आपति प्रकट कर सकेगा; 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपति सक्षम प्राधिकारी एवं अतिरिक्त विशेष भूमि अधिग्रहण अधिकारी, प्रथम तल, आपदा प्रबंधन 


भवन, महसूल भवन, कलेक्टर ऑफिस, सुभाषत्रिज सर्कल के पास, अहमदाबाद को लिखित रुप मे किया जाएगा जो कि 
आक्षेप का आधार होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी आक्षेपकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रुप से या कानुनी प्रेक्टिशनर के माध्यम से सुनवाई का

CORRIGENDUM NOTIFICATION 
This notification supersedes the Notification S.O. 4376(E), published on 05/0/2023 


5.0. 4493(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section(I) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 
989 (24 of 989) ( hereinafter referred in as the said act), the Central Government after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
execution of the special Railway Project, namely, 4th LINE BETWEEN BAREJADI NANDEJ (GERATPUR) - 
SANAND (38.20KM) IN DISTRICT AHMEDABAD in the state of Gujarat, hereby declares its intention to acquired 
such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(I) of section 20D of the said Act; 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, and Additional Special Land Acquisition 
Officer, First Floor, Disaster Management building, Mahesul Bhavan, Collector Office, Near Subhash bridge circle, 
Ahmedabad, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may after hearing all such objections and after

objections; 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (ID) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2th October, 2023 


S.O. 4482(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NHII9 in the 
stretch of land for Kotdwar Bypass of NH-!9 from Km. 0.500 to Km. 6.500 in the state of UTTARKHAND, hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, ADM Pauri Garhwal in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, 
either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

5.0. 4443(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (I) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 
989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred in as the said act), the Central Government after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
execution of the special Railway Project, namely, NEW BG LINE INTERSECTIONS (5 NOS.) BETWEEN 
GERATPUR-SANAND AND BOTAD- AHMEDABAD (6.5! KMS) IN AHMEDABAD DISTRICT in the state of 
Gujarat, hereby declares its intention to acquired such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section(I) of section 20D of the said Act; 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority and Additional Special Land Acquisition 
Officer, First Floor, Disaster Management building, Mahesul Bhavan, Collector Office, Near Subhash bridge circle, 
Ahmedabad, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may after hearing all such objections and after 
making such further enquiry, if any as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow 


the objections; 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (II) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be 


final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट गुजरात राज्य की तहसील- वागरा की भूमि में गुजरात राज्य में कांडला (गुजरात) से गोरखपुर (उत्तर प्रदेश) तक

और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में श्री अवलाभाई खातराभाई बारीआ, सक्षम प्राधिकारी और 


डिप्टी कलेक्टर (सेवानिवृत्त), कांडला गोरखपुर एल.पी.जी. पाइपलाइन परियोजना, आई.एच.बी. लिमिटेड, गुजरात ने केन्द्रीय सरकार 
को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है। 


और केन्द्रीय सरकार ने उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह समाधान हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि पाइपलाइन

MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 22nd September, 2023 


S.O. 4453(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum 
and Natural Gas, published in the Gazette No. 1685 date: 18.04.2023 S.O No. 1765(E) date 31.03.2023 part- 
II,Section-3,Sub-Section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines 
(Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962 (50 of 1962), (Here in after referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land situated in Tehsil — Vagra in 
Gujarat State, specified in the schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying pipeline for the 
transportation of LPG from Kandla inthe State of Gujarat to Gorakhpur in the State of Uttar Pradesh by the IHB 
Limited for implementing the “Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project’. 


And whereas the copies of the said gazette notification were made available to the public upto 28/06/2023. 


And whereas Shri Avalabhai Khatarabhai Baria, Competent Authority and Deputy Collector (Retd.), 
Kandla Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project, IHB Limited, Gujarat has under sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act, 
has submitted his report to Central Government. 


And whereas, the Central Government after considering the report and on being satisfied that the said land 
is required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of the user therein; 


Now therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the schedule appended to 
this notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline; 

And further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of section 6 of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user of the said land for laying the pipeline shall, instead of vesting 
in the Central Government, vests on the date of publication of this declaration, in IHB Limited, free from 
all encumbrances . 


THB Limited shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of section 10 of the P&MP 
Act, 1962 and no suit, claim or legal proceeding would lie against the Central Government on any matter 
relating to pipeline.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2th October, 2023 


S.O. 4472(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, being S.0.9l9(E), dated New Delhi, the 26" April , 2023, published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A (in respect of R.S. 
plots) of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of l956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for 
building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NHI6A on the stretch of land from 
Km 45.5 to Km 229.00 (Kharagpur-Bardhaman-Moregram Economic Corridor) in the district of BIRBHUM in the 
state of WEST BENGAL. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Bartaman” dated 0.06.2023 ; and 
“The Statesman” dated 9.05.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A (in respect of R.S. plots) of the said Act; 


And whereas no objections are found to have been received, and as such the question of hearing and disposal 
of objection dose not arise; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


20 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4469(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4978(अ) दिनांक 20.10.2022, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, SHAVE (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा गुजरात राज्य के छोटाउदेपुर जिले में NH-56 के 
कि.मी. 95+550 से कि.मी. 132+250 (प्रांत अधिकारी, बोडेली) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार 
लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का.आ. 4978(अ) दिनांक 20.10.2022 का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की 
उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 08.12.2022 को “ द टाईम्स ऑफ इंडिया” और “ गुजरात समाचार ” दोनों में प्रकाशित 
किया गया था; 


और AAT प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 

59.0. 4469(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highway, S.O. 4978(E) dated 20.10.2022 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part वी, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening /four-laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH-56 on the stretch of land from Km 95+550 to Km 132+250 in (Prant Officer, Bodeli) in the District of 
Chhotaudepur in the State of GUJARAT. 

And whereas the substance of the said notification $.0.4978 (E) dated 20.10.2022 has been published 
in “The Times of India" and "Gujarat Samachar” both dated 08.12.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of 
the said Act; 

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 2th October, 2023 
S.O. 4463(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 234 Dated:25/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 


annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH7 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 32.55 in the district of Fazilka in the state of Punjab. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune (English) and 


“Punjabi Tribune” both dated /3.06.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 


competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4474(E).—hereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 6149 Dated:29/12/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed 
to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH105 in 
the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 43.319 (BATHINDA) in the district of MOGA in the state of PUNJAB. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Zhe Hindustan Times” and 
“Jagbani” both dated 25.01.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

5.0. 4487(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for

of Nagapattinam in the state of TAMIL NADU, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special District Revenue Officer 
(LA -NH ), Nagapattinam in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final.

inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 4484(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways

Km. 47 (Saharanpur) in the district of SAHARANPUR in the state of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making

44A in the district of JAMMU in the UT of J&K

notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Deputy Commissioner Jammu 
(Wazarat Road, Jammu) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, 


either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4476(E).—) In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956), (hereinafter reffered to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required 
for building maintenance, management and operation of National Highway From Km. 189.000 to Km. 190.230 of the 
NH333A _ (Barbigha-Sheikhpura-Sikandra-Jamui-Jhajha- Banka-Panjawara-Bihar Jharkhand border section) for 
building (widening/Tow laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation in the district of Godda in the State of 


Jharkhand, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (i) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, the District Land Acquisition Officer, 
Godda in writing and shall set out the ground thereof and the competent authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority think necessary, by order, either allow or 


disallow the objections. 
Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 30 of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 


by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4483(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Kotdwar 
Bypass of NH119 from Km. 0.000 to Km. 0.500 in the district of BIUNOR in the state of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby 


declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer, 
Bijnor in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further inquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 


disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4462(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1960 Dated:28/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH7 in the stretch of land from Km. 87.75 to Km. 80.2 (District Commissioner Complex Shri Muktsar Sahib), 
NH9 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 7 (DC Office Shri Muktsar sahib) in the district of SRI MUKTSAR 
SAHIB in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune (English) and 
“Jagbani (Punjabi)” both dated 10.05.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
(North Eastern Railway /Construction Organization) 
Gorakhpur, the 2th October, 2023 


S.O. 4492(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Eastern Railway, Construction Origination), Notification number, 8.0. 3455 (E) dated the 3 August, 2023 published 
in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated 02" August, 2023 (hereinafter referred to 
as the said notification) and issued under sub-section () of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (] 
of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of Special Railway Project, namely Sahjanwa-Dohrighat New line Railway project (8l.7 km.) in 
Tehsil Shajanwa (.00 km) of Gorakhpur District in the State of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely "Dainik 
Jagran"' and ''The Times of India" Dated 05" August , 2023 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, the competent Authority hasreceived no objection in this project against the notification. And 
whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its report to the 
Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4478(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building for 
“Upgradation to 2 laning with paved shoulders”, maintenance, management and operation of NH-217 in the stretch of 
land from Km. 198.80 to Km 204.00 (Darugre to Karonggre Section) in the district of West Garo Hills in the state of 
MEGHALAYA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Deputy Commissioner, WGH in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


9.0. 4473(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5788 Dated:12/12/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH105 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 43.319 (Moga) in the district of MOGA in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune” and “Jagbani” both 
dated 07.01.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 4477(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for construction 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-93]A in 
the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 23.950 in the district of RAEBARELI in the state of UTTAR PRADESH, 


hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Additional Collector 
(Administration)/ Special Land Acquisition Officer (J.O.), Raebareli in writing and shall set out the grounds 
thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a 
legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 


Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 12th October, 2023 


S.O. 4466(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.2865 Dated:30/06/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
proposed Bangalore-Chennai Expressway NHNE-7 in the stretch of land design chainage from Km. 11/450 to design 
chainage Km. 71/000 in the district of Kolar in the state of Karnataka; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vartha Bharathi” in Kannada 
Language and “Times of India” in English Language both dated 18-07-2023, under sub-section (3) of section 3A of 
the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority;

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that in publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2th October, 2023 


S.O. 4485(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH2] 
in the stretch of land from Km. [73.,900 to Km. !79.60 (Sundernagar-Bypass, H.P) in the district of MANDI in the 
state of HIMACHAL PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, AC to DC in writing and shall set 
out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in 
person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if 
any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act 
shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 21st September, 2023 
S.O. 4494(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of the India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas S.O. No. 2708(E) Dated 20 June 2023 published in the Gazette of the India Gazette No. 2594 Dated 20 
June 2023 and under sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of 
User in Land) Act, 1962 (50 of 1962), (hereinafter referred to as the said Act) the Central Government declared its 
intention to acquire the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for the purpose 


of laying “Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project” for the transportation of LPG in Tehsil Sanwer, District Indore In 
the state of Madhya Pradesh by IHB Limited. 


And whereas copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public up to 28 june 2023 
And whereas Dr. Ram Prakash Tiwari, the Competent Authority has under sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act 
submitted report to the Central Government; 


And whereas the Central Government, after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of user therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 6 of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the LPG pipeline. 

And further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of section 6 of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user in the said land for laying the pipeline shall instead of vesting in the 
Central Government, vests on the date of publication of this declaration in IHB Limited, free from all encumbrances. 


THB Limited shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of Section 10 of the P&MP Act, 1962 
and no suit, claim or legal proceeding would be against the Central Government on any matter relating to the pipeline.

9.0. 4506(E).—Whereas, the Mediation Act, 2023 (32 of 2023) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act) 
received the assent of the President on the 4" September, 2023; 


And, whereas, section 32 of the said Act provides for the composition of the Mediation Council of India; 


And, whereas, clause (०) of section 3 of the said Act defines the term “Member” which means a Full-Time or 
Part-Time Member of the Council and includes the Chairperson; 


And, whereas, sub-section (3) of section 32 of the said Act provides for prescribing rules in respect of 
salaries, allowances and other terms and conditions of Members; 


And, whereas, sub-section (4) of section 32 and clause (b) of sub-section (2) of section 5l of the said Act 
provides for prescribing rules in respect of travelling and other allowances payable to the Member; 


And, whereas, rules being made under sub-section (4) of section 32 of the said Act shall be applicable only to 
the Part-Time Members and allowances in respect of the Full-Time Members shall be covered under the rules being 
made under sub-section (3) of section 32 of the said Act; 


And, whereas, it may cause confusion and difficulty, in notifying the rules for the travelling and other 
allowances payable to Part-Time Member of the Mediation Council of India under sub-section (4) of section 32 of the 
said Act unless the word “Member” is substituted with the words “Part-Time Member”; 


And, whereas, the Tenth Schedule to the said Act provides for amendments to the Consumer Protection Act, 
209 (35 of 209); 


And, whereas, section 37 of the Consumer Protection Act, 20l9 (35 of 209) provides that District 
Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall either on an application 
by the parties may refer the dispute for settlement by mediation under the Mediation Act, 2023 (32 of 2023); 


And, whereas, section 7 of the Mediation Act, 2023 (32 of 2023) provides for power of the court or tribunal 
to refer the parties to mediation and section 37 of the Consumer Protection Act, 20l9 (35 of 20l9), as amended 
through the Tenth Schedule of the Mediation Act, 2023 (32 of 2023) is not in consonance with section 7 of the said 
Act and the words “shall either on an application by the parties” needs to be replaced with the word “may” to remove 
the difficulty in implementing the said provision. 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 54 of the Mediation Act, 
2023, the Central Government hereby makes the following Order to remove the above said difficulties, namely:— 


. Short title and commencement.— (|) This order may be called the Mediation (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 
2023. 


(2) It shall come into force with effect from the 3 . day of October, 2023. 
2. In the Mediation Act, 2023,— 


(a) in section 32, in sub-section (4), for the word “Member”, the words “Part-Time Member” shall be 
substituted; 


(b) in section 5, in sub-section (2), in clause (b), for the word “Member”, the words “Part-Time Member” 
shall be substituted; 


(c) nthe Tenth Schedule, relating to amendments to the Consumer Protection Act, 209, in section 37, for 
the words “shall either on an application by the parties”, the word “may” shall be substituted.

F. No. 01/94/180/028/AM24/PC-4.—In exercise of powers conferred under Paragraph 1.03 and 2.04 of the

Existing para 4.10 (i) 


Transfer of any duty-free material imported or procured 
against Advance Authorisation from one unit of a 
company to another unit for manufacturing purpose 
shall be done with prior intimation to jurisdictional 
Customs Authority. Benefit of Input Tax Credit shall 
not be claimed on such transferred input. 


Transfer of any duty-free material imported or procured 
against Advance Authorisation from one unit of a 
company to another unit for manufacturing purpose 
shall be done with prior intimation to jurisdictional 
Customs Authority. In case of transfer of duty free 
imported or indigenously procured materials, on which

or different States, the availment of Input Tax Credit 
shall be governed as per the provisions of the GST law 


& the rules made thereunder.

और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी को इस परियोजना में मिले सभी आक्षेपों का निस्तारण सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा कर दिया 
गया है 

और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ड की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट सौंप दी है ; 


अतः अब केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी से उक्त रिपोर्ट के प्राप्त होने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ड 
की STAT (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषण करती है कि इससे उपाबद्ध अनूसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की जाएगी | 


यह और केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम कि धारा 20ड की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
राजपत्र मे इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशित होने पर इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विलंगमों से मुक्त होकर 
केन्द्रीय सरकार में आत्यांकित रूप से निहित हो जाएगी। 

और, यह कि केन्द्रीय सरकार द्वारा उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 (च) की उपधारा (04) के अनुसरण में उर्पयुक्त 
वर्णित भूमि में सभी हितबद्ध व्यक्तियों को सूचित किया जाता है कि वे व्यक्तिगत रूप से या किसी अभिकर्ता या विधि

NOTIFICATION 
Prayagraj, the 11th October, 2023 


S.O. 4500(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Central Railway, Construction department), Notification number, S.O. 2243 (E) dated the 23 May, 2023 published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 23 May, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as 
the said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 
2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of Special Railway Project, namely special railway project of Prayagraj-Pt. Deendayal 3™ line doubling 
Railway project (150 km) in District Prayagraj in the state of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Amar 
Ujala” and “HHindustan” Dated 30" May, 2023 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, The All the objections received by the competent authority in this project have been resolved 
by the competent authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances. 


And, that all persons interested in the above mentioned land in pursuance of sub-section (04) of section 20 (F) of the 
said Act by the Central Government are hereby informed that they may, personally or through an agent or legal 
practitioner, be notified by the competent authority Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organisation) Prayagraj, can 
submit his claim in the next 20 days from the date of publication of this notification in the office of the Competent 
Authority.

NOTIFICATION 

Prayagraj, the |lth October, 2023 
S.O. 4499(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Central Railway, Construction department), Notification number, 8.0. 2243 (E) dated the 23 May, 2023 published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 23 May, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as 
the said notification) and issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (I of 
2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of Special Railway Project, namely special railway project of Prayagraj-Pt. Deendayal 3™ line doubling 

Railway project ({50 km) in District Prayagraj in the state of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Amar 
Ujala” and “HHindustan” Dated 307 May, 2023 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, The All the objections received by the competent authority in this project have been resolved 
by the competent authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances. 


And, that all persons interested in the above mentioned land in pursuance of sub-section (04) of section 20 
(F) of the said Act by the Central Government are hereby informed that they may, personally or through an agent or 
legal practitioner, be notified by the competent authority Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organisation) Prayagraj, can 
submit his claim in the next 20 days from the date of publication of this notification in the office of the Competent 
Authority.

Bengaluru, the 13th October, 2023 


F. No. DS_5-18013/8/2023-V.—With the success of the Chandrayaan-3 Mission on 23"! August, 2023 with 
the landing of the Vikram lander and deployment of the Pragyaan Rover on the lunar surface, India joins an elite 
group of Space faring nations becoming the fourth country to land on the moon and the first nation to land near to 
South pole of the moon. The outcome of this historic mission will benefit mankind in the years to come; 


2. And whereas, this day marks an important milestone in the Country’s advancements in Space Missions, 
inspire younger generations towards enhanced interest in pursuing STEM and provide a major impetus to the Space 
sector; 


De Now, therefore, the Government of India has declared 23 Day of the August of every year as the 
“NATIONAL SPACE DAY” to commemorate this historic moment.

ख. योजना के तहत, एक निवेशक नीलामी में केवल एक ही बोली लगा सकता Sl इस आशय का एक वचनपत्र कि निवेशक

बोलियां लगाना: 


प्रत्येक एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर अपने घटकों से प्राप्त दृढ़ आदेशों के आधार पर अपने सभी घटकों की ओर से भारतीय रिजर्व 
बैंक कोर बैंकिंग सॉल्यूशन (ई-कुबेर) प्रणाली पर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक प्रारूप में एकल समेकित गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी बोली प्रस्तुत 
करेगा। भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक कोर बैंकिंग सॉल्यूशन (ई-कुबेर) प्रणाली की सामान्य विफलता जैसी असाधारण परिस्थितियों 
को छोड़कर, भौतिक रूप में गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी बोली स्वीकार नहीं की जाएगी। 


बोलियों का आवंटन: 


च. 


एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी खंड के तहत आवंटन प्रतिफल/मूल्य की भारित औसत दर पर होगा जो प्रतिस्पर्धी 
बोली के आधार पर नीलामी में सामने आएगा। प्रतिभूतियां एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को जारी करने की तारीख को भुगतान 
के बदले जारी की जाएंगी, भले ही उन्होंने अपने ग्राहकों से भुगतान प्राप्त किया हो। 


ड.. यदि बोली की कुल राशि आरक्षित राशि (अधिसूचित राशि का 5%) से अधिक है, तो आनुपातिक आवंटन किया 


जाएगा। आंशिक आवंटन के मामले में, यह एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर की जिम्मेदारी होगी कि वे अपने ग्राहकों को पारदर्शी 
तरीके से प्रतिभूतियों का उचित आवंटन करें। 


यदि बोली की कुल राशि आरक्षित राशि से कम है, तो कमी को प्रतिस्पर्धी हिस्से में ले जाया जाएगा। 


सुरक्षा का मुद्दा: 


भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा प्रतिभूति केवल एसजीएल रूप में जारी की जाएगी। एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी 
बोलियों की निविदा के समय उनके मुख्य एसजीएल या सीएसजीएल खाते में जमा की जाने वाली राशि (अंकित मूल्य) 
को स्पष्ट रूप से इंगित करना होगा। 


ज. बाद में निवेशक के कहने पर मुख्य एसजीएल खाते से भौतिक रूप में डिलीवरी की अनुमति है। 


यह एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर की जिम्मेदारी होगी कि वे अपने ग्राहकों को प्रतिभूतियां दें। असाधारण परिस्थितियों को 
छोड़कर, ग्राहकों को प्रतिभूतियों का हस्तांतरण जारी होने की तारीख से पांच कार्य दिवसों के भीतर पूरा किया जाना 
चाहिए। 

ग्राहकों से लिया जाने वाला कमीशन/ब्रोकरेज 
एग्रीगेटर/सुविधाकर्ता अपने ग्राहकों को यह सेवा प्रदान करने के लिए ब्रोकरेज/कमीशन/सेवा शुल्क के रूप 
में प्रति ₹ 100 पर छह पैसे तक की वसूली कर सकते हैं। ऐसी लागतों को बिक्री मूल्य में शामिल किया जा सकता है या 
ग्राहकों से अलग से वसूल किया जा सकता है। 
यदि प्रतिभूतियां जारी होने की तिथि के बाद प्रतिभूतियों को स्थानांतरित किया जाता है, तो ग्राहक द्वारा 
एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को देय प्रतिफल राशि में जारी होने की तारीख से अर्जित ब्याज शामिल होगा। 
ग्राहकों से प्रतिभूतियों की लागत, उपार्जित ब्याज, जहां कहीं लागू हो, और दलाली/कमीशन/सेवा प्रभारों के लिए ग्राहक 
से अनुबंध के अनुसार एग्रीगेटर/सुविधाकर्ता द्वारा भुगतान प्राप्त करने के तौर-तरीके तय किए जा सकते हैं। 


यह ध्यान दिया जा सकता है कि कोई अन्य लागत, जैसे कि फंडिंग लागत, को मूल्य में नहीं बनाया जाना चाहिए या 
ग्राहक से वसूल नहीं किया जाना चाहिए। 


Vil. रिपोर्टिंग आवश्यकताएं: 


एग्रीगेटर्स/फैसिलिटेटरों को योजना के तहत संचालन से संबंधित जानकारी भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (बैंक) को प्रस्तुत करनी होगी, 
जैसा कि समय-समय पर बैंक द्वारा निर्धारित समय सीमा के भीतर कहा जा सकता है। 


VII. उपरोक्त दिशानिर्देश बैंक द्वारा समीक्षा के अधीन हैं और तदनुसार, यदि और जब आवश्यक समझा जाता है, तो योजना में 
संशोधन किया जाएगा।

Scheme for Non-competitive Bidding Facility in the Auction of 
Government of India Dated Securities and Treasury Bills 


Scope: With a view to encouraging wider participation and retail holding of Government securities, retail 
investors are allowed participation on “non-competitive” basis in select auctions of dated Government of India 
(Gol) securities and Treasury Bills. 


Definitions: For the purpose of this scheme, the terms shall bear the meaning assigned to them as under: 


a. Retail investor is any person, including individuals, firms, companies, corporate bodies, institutions, 
provident funds, trusts, and any other entity as may be prescribed by RBI. 


b. ‘Aggregator/Facilitator’ means a Scheduled Bank or Primary Dealer or Specified Stock Exchange or any 
other entity approved by RBI, permitted to aggregate the bids received from the investors and submit a 
single bid in the non-competitive segment of the primary auction. 


c. ‘Specified stock exchange’ means SEBI recognized Stock Exchange, which have received No Objection 
Certificate (NOC) from SEBI to act as aggregator/facilitator in the primary auction segment. 


d. ‘Eligible Provident Funds’ are those non-government provident funds governed by the Provident Funds 
Act, 1925 whose investment pattern is decided by the Government of India. 


Eligibility: 
a. Participation on a non-competitive basis in the auctions will be open to a retail investor who: 


i. Does not maintain current account (CA) or subsidiary General Ledger (SGL) account with the 
Reserve Bank of India; and 


ii. Submits the bid indirectly through an Aggregator/Facilitator permitted under the scheme; or 
iii. Maintains the ‘Retail Direct Gilt Account’ (RDG Account) with RBI 


Exceptions: 
a. Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Cooperative Banks: 


i. Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Cooperative Banks shall be covered under this Scheme only in 
the auctions of dated securities in view of their statutory obligations. 


ii. Since these banks maintain SGL account and current account with the Reserve Bank of India, they 
shall be eligible to submit their non-competitive bids directly. 


b. State Governments, eligible provident funds and Others: 


i. State Governments, eligible provident funds in India, the Nepal Rashtra Bank, Royal Monetary 
Authority of Bhutan and any Person or Institution, specified by the Bank, with the approval of 
Government, shall be covered under this scheme only in the auctions of Treasury Bills. 


ii. These bids will be outside the notified amount. 
iii. There will not be any restriction on the maximum amount of bid for these entities. 


Quantum: Allocation of non-competitive bids from retail investors will be restricted to a maximum of five 
percent of the aggregate nominal amount of the issue within the notified amount as specified by the 
Government of India, or any other percentage determined by Reserve Bank of India. 


Amount of Bid: 


a. The minimum amount for bidding will be 210,000 (face value) and therefore in multiples in 10,000 as 
hitherto. 


b. Inthe auctions of Gol dated securities, the retail investors can make a single bid for an amount not more 
than Rupees Two crore (face value) per security per auction. 


VI. Other Operational Guidelines: 


a. The retail investor desirous of participating in the auction under the Scheme would be required to 
maintain a depository account with any of the depositories or a gilt accounS under the constituent 
subsidiary general ledger (CSGL) account of Aggregator/Facilitator or ‘Retail Direct Gilt Account’ 
(RDG Account) with RBI.

b. 


Under the Scheme, an investor can make only a single bid in an auction. An undertaking to the effect that 
the investor is making only a single bid will have to obtained and kept on record by the 
Aggregator/Facilitator. 


Submission of Bids: 


९. 


Each Aggregator/Facilitator on the basis of firm orders received from their constituents with submit a 
single consolidated non-competitive bid on behalf of all its constituents in electronic format on the 
Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system. Except in extraordinary circumstances 
such as general failure of the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system, non- 
competitive bid in physical form will not be accepted. 


Allotment of Bids: 


d. 


Allotment under the non-competitive segment to the Aggregator/Facilitator will be at the weighted 
average rate of yield/price that will emerge in the auction on the basis of the competitive bidding. The 
securities will be issued to the Aggregator/Facilitator against payment on the date of issue irrespective of 
whether they have received payment from their clients. 


In case the aggregate amount of bid is more than the reserved amount (5% of notified amount), pro rata 
allotment would be made. In case of partial allotments, it will be the responsibility of the 
Aggregator/Facilitator to appropriately allocate securities to their clients in a transparent manner. 


In case the aggregate amount of bids is less than the reserved amount, the shortfall will be taken to 
competitive portion. 


Issue of Security: 


2. 


Security would be issued only in SGL form by RBI. The Aggregator/Facilitator has to clearly indicate at 
the time of tendering the non-competitive bids the amounts (face value) to be credited to their main SGL 
or CSGL account. 


Delivery in physical form from the Main SGL account is permissible at the instance of the investor 
subsequently. 


It will be the responsibility of the Aggregator/Facilitator to pass on the securities to their clients. Except 
in extraordinary circumstances, the transfer of securities to the client should b completed within five 
working days from the date of issue. 


Commission/Brokerage charged to Clients: 


j. 


The Aggregator/Facilitator can recover up to six paise per हैं 100 as brokerage/commission/service 
charges for rendering this service to their clients. Such costs may be built into the sale price or recovered 
separately from the clients. 


In case, the securities are transferred subsequent to the issue date of the security, the consideration 
amount payable by the client to the Aggregator/Facilitator will include accrued interest from the date of 
issue. 


Modalities for obtaining payment from clients towards cost of the securities, accrued interest, wherever 
applicable, and brokerage/commission/service charges may be worked out by the Aggregator/Facilitator 
as per agreement with the client. 


It may be noted that no other costs, such as funding costs, should be built into the price or recovered 
from the client. 


VII. Reporting Requirements: 


Aggregators/Facilitators will be required to furnish information relating to operations under the Scheme to the 
Reserve Bank of India (Bank) as may be called for from time to time within the time frame prescribed by the 
Bank. 


VIII. The aforesaid guidelines are subject to review by the Bank and accordingly, if and when considered 
necessary, the Scheme will be modified.

का.आ. 4521(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 432 (अ) दिनांक 25.01.2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र 
सं. 418 दिनांक 27.01.2023 , असाधारण, भाग 1 खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तमिलनाडु राज्य 
के वेल्लोर जिले में एनएच-234 (नया एनएच 75) मैंगलोर-विल्लुपुरम रोड के किमी47/400-73/250 में वेल्लोर 
बाईपास के निर्माण के लिए तक के भूखण्ड पर निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "19.02.2023 " 
को "डेली थांथी" और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

New Delhi, the 16th October, 2023 


S.O. 4521(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, 8.0 432 (E) Dated:25.01.2023 , published in the Gazette of India No. 418 dated 
27.01.2023, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the 
National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government 
declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Land 
Acquisition for Construction of Vellore Bypass from Km 47/400-73/250 of NH-234 (New NH 75)Mangalore- 
Villupuram road in the district of VELLORE in the state of TAMIL NADU 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Daily Thanthi” and “Times of 
India” both dated 19.02.2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 25 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4533(अ).--राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम की धारा 3ए की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग 
करते हुए, 1956 (1956 का 48) (इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित), केंद्र सरकार, इस बात से संतुष्ट होने के 
बाद कि सार्वजनिक उद्देश्य के लिए भूमि, जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, निर्माण के लिए आवश्यक 
है (चौड़ीकरण/छह लेन आदि), कर्नाटक राज्य के दावणगेरे जिले में किमी 260.000 से किमी 330.923 तक भूमि के खंड में 
एनएच4 का रखरखाव, प्रबंधन और संचालन, इसके द्वारा ऐसी भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने के अपने इरादे की घोषणा करता 
है। 

उक्त भूमि में रुचि रखने वाला कोई भी व्यक्ति, इस अधिसूचना के आधिकारिक राजपत्र में प्रकाशन की तारीख से 
इक्कीस दिनों के भीतर, धारा 3सी की उप-धारा (1) के तहत उक्त उद्देश्य के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर आपत्ति जता 
सकता है। अधिनियम कहा। 

ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ विशेष भू-अर्जन अधिकारी, चित्रदुर्ग को लिखित रूप में की जाएगी 
और उसके लिए आधार निर्धारित करेगा और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप से या कानूनी व्यवसायी द्वारा 
सुनवाई का अवसर देगा। और ऐसी सभी आपत्तियों को सुनने के बाद और ऐसी और जांच करने के बाद, यदि कोई हो, जैसा 
कि सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा, या तोआपत्तियों को अनुमति दें या अस्वीकार करें।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th October, 2023 


S.O. 4533.(E) In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/Six lane etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH4 in the stretch of land from Km 260.000 to 
Km 330.923 in the district of Davanagere in the state of KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such 
land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer 
Chitradurga in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.
