NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th October, 2023 
S.0.4536 (E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 

(widening/Six/Eight laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Mumbai- Vadodara Expressway Spur to 


NH-NF4 in the stretch of land from Km. 8.925 to Km. 45.400 (Maharashtra Section) in the district of Thane in the 


state of Maharashtra, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section () of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer, Bhiwandi 
Divsion Bhiwandi, Thane Maharashtra in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority 
shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing 
all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 


order, either allow or disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

land.

notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act.

No.i3, Pune in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections.

final.

inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th October, 2023 

S.O. 457(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 925(E) Dated:26/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of NH-l30D 
in the stretch of land from Km. 20.400 to Km. 48.800 in the District of Narayanpur in the state of Chhattisgarh. 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Karamkranti” and “ Chanel 
India” both dated /4.05.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 4534(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act,1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required 
for building (Six-Laninge, widening etc) maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No-544 in 
the stretch of the land from Km.236.135 to Km.264.490 (Vadakkenchery-Thrissur Section) of NH544 in the district 
of Thrissur in the state of Kerala, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, "The Special Deputy 
Collector, LANH(NH-66) Kodungallur "in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, 
after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either, allow or disallow the objections.

New Delhi, the l6th October, 2023 


S.O. 4525(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 23i5 Dated:25/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, !956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH965 in the stretch of land from Km. 76 to Km. 226 (New collector office , Pune) in the district of PUNE in the 
state of MAHARASHTRA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Maharastra Times” and “Indian 
Express” both dated !4 June 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th October, 2023 


S.O. 4522(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, !76! Dated:!7/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary No.l68], Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH-332A in the stretch of land from Km. 76 to Km. 07.938 (Mamallapuram - Puducherry Section) in 
the district of PUDUCHERRY in the Union Territory of PONDICHERRY 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The New Indian Express” and 
“Dinamalar” both dated 6.05.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objections have been received from any persons by the competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l6th October, 2023 


S.O. 4520(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 62 Dated:05/0/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) 
issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as 
the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH60 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 42 to Km. 97 (B WING , NEW COLLECTOR OFFICE, OPP SASUN HOSPITAL PUNE - 
) in the district of PUNE in the state of MAHARASHTRA; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Indian Express” and “Maharastra 
Time” both dated 02/03/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4518(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. का.आ. 1212(अ) तारीख 14/03/2023, जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा असम राज्य के कछार जिले में NH306 के 
कि.मी. 20+000 से कि.मी. 49+360 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), 
अनुरक्षण, TAIT और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 19 मार्च, 2023 
को "दैनिक जुगशंका” और ”असम ट्रिब्यून” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था 

और AAT प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th October, 2023 

S.O. 4518(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.1212 (E) Dated:14/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH306 in the stretch of land from Km 20+000 to Km 49+360 in the district of CACHAR in the state of 
ASSAM 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik jugashanka” and “Assam 


Tribune” both dated 19.03.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 


competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 
And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

to as the said Act) the Central Government declared its intention to be acquired the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway 
Project, namely, Anand-Godhra doubling Project in District Kheda in the State of Gujarat. 


And, whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily local newspaper “Sandesh” dated 
i8" June 2023 & 287 June 2023, “Divya Bhaskar” dated 297 July 2023, “The Indian Express” dated 8"" June 2023, 
28" June 2023 & 29" July 2023 under subsection (4) of section 20A of the said Act; And, whereas, no objection has 
been received by the competent authority; 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (I) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report of the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And, further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central government here by 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette the land specified in the schedule annexed here 
to shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l6th October, 2023 


S.O. 455(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 963 Dated:03/03/2022, 496l Dated:20/0/2022, 474 Dated:28/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of 
India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National 
Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its 
intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four- 
laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield Expressway in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to 
Km. 7.8 (Prant Office, Tharad) in the district of Banaskantha in the state of GUJARAT; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Times of India” and “Sandesh” 
both dated 2].04.2023 & Dated 30.2.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th October, 2023 


G.S.R. 744(E).—The following draft notification which the Central Government proposes to issue, in 
exercise of the powers conferred by sections 3, 6, and 25 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 (29 of 1986), for 
making certain amendments in the Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016, issued vide G.S.R. 320 (BE), dated the 18" 
March, 2016, is hereby published as required under sub-rule (3) of rule 5 of the Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986, 
for information of the public likely to be affected thereby and notice is hereby given that the said notification will be 
taken into consideration by the Central Government on or after the expiry of sixty days from the date on which copies 
of this notification as published in the Gazette of India are made available to the public; 


Any person interested in making any objection or suggestion on the proposals contained in the draft 
notification may do so in writing within the period so specified through post to the Secretary, Ministry of 
Environment, Forest & Climate Change, Indira Paryavaran Bhawan, Jor Bagh Road, Aliganj, New Delhi-110003 or 
electronically at email address: satyendra.kumar07 @nic.in , amit.love@nic.in . 


Draft Notification 


Whereas, the Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016 (hereinafter referred to as the “said rules”) were 
notified by Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change vide G.S.R. 320 (E), dated the 187 March, 2016 to 
provide statutory framework for plastic waste management in the country in an environmentally sound manner; 


Whereas, in order further strengthen the effective implementation of rules amendments are being proposed 
inter alia including comprehensive coverage of supply chain actors plastic raw material through registration under the 
rules; introduce regime for environmentally sound management of compostable and biodegradable plastics; use of 
information technology tools for online reporting replacing multi-step manual reporting and capturing of data at 
various stages of waste management at state and local authority level; provide for online electronic trading platform 
for trading of certificates generated by registered plastic waste processors for price discovery. 


Now, therefore, in the exercise of the powers conferred by sections 6, 8 and 25 of the Environment 
(Protection) Act, 1986 (29 of 1986), read with clause (d) of sub-rule (3) of rule 5 of the said Environment (Protection) 
Rules, 1986 the Central Government hereby publishes this draft notification as required under sub-rule 3 of rule 5 of 
the said Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986, which shall on and from the date of its final publication make the 
following amendments in the said notification, namely:—

हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि तमिलनाडु राज्य के विरुधुनगर जिले में NH744 के कि.मी. 31.8 से कि.मी.70.981 तक के भू-

प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के 
अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्नकीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ विशेष जिला राजस्व अधिकारी (एलए), एनएच -744, 
विरुधुनगर को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, 
आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई

New Delhi, the 16th October, 2023 


S.0.4538(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is 
required for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH744 in the stretch of land from Km. 31.8 to Km. 70.981 in the district of VIRUDHUNAGAR in 
the state of TAMIL NADU, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) 
of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special District Revenue 
Officer (LA), NH-744, Virudhunagar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and 
may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority 
thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall 
be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can 
be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th October, 2023 


S.O. 4524(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, 896(E) Dated:25/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part IL, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation 
of NH26 in the stretch of land from Km. 49.988 to Km. I50.087 (Kesinga) in the district of KALAHANDI in the 
state of ODISHA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Prameya” and “The New 
Indian Express” both dated .06.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


6 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
